content.subject: white-bearded old man
content.costume: vintage circus performer costume, shoulder satchel

negative_original: watermark, text, realistic photo, official screenshot, extra fingers, low resolution, messy background

templates.flux_ref: Keep this man's face and art style exactly the same as in the image. He is {theme}, a {subject}. Show him from the waist up. Outfit: {costume}. He has a {expression} and is {action}. Style: {style}, {composition}.
templates.flux_noref: {theme}, a {subject}, shown from the waist up. Outfit: {costume}. He has a {expression} and is {action}. Style: {style}, {composition}.

checklist_must: white beard, round nose, cheerful old face (reference)
notes: TRANSLATION (documented): original prompt is Chinese: '奥兹巫师，白胡子老人，复古马戏团表演服，挎包，狡黠微笑，变戏法，复古马戏团风格，正方形构图'. SD1.5's CLIP encoder cannot read Chinese, so both models get the English translation.
img01 and img02 have different hats/coats (black star hat vs striped hat); identity is judged on face, white beard and feather only.
Cartoon control for Oz; only normal-proportion elderly male in the benchmark.
